topics.title: OpenAI details defenses against adversarial distillation to protect reasoning traces
topics.summary: On November 20, 2026, OpenAI published a report detailing technical defenses against adversarial distillation targeting frontier models. Red-teaming showed extraction attack success rates against hidden reasoning dropped from 54.0% to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra, as OpenAI introduced cryptographic context binding, hardened API boundaries, and disruption of illicit scraping operations.

topics.title: UK Financial Conduct Authority launches AI Spotlight Observatory for financial sector
topics.summary: On November 19, 2026, the UK Financial Conduct Authority launched the AI Spotlight Observatory, a regulatory platform tracking practical AI adoption across financial services. Developed with CFTE and NayaOne, the observatory categorizes real-world AI use cases from over 200 institutions across 150 activity areas to benchmark implementation and promote safe deployment.

topics.title: New York breaks ground on permanent Empire AI supercomputing center at University at Buffalo
topics.summary: On November 19, 2026, New York Governor Kathy Hochul broke ground on the permanent 46,000-square-foot home of Empire AI at the University at Buffalo. The $500 million public-private supercomputing initiative, uniting SUNY, CUNY, Columbia, and other institutions, will house Empire AI Gamma by 2028 for academic research in medicine, climate, and materials.

sources.publisher: Office of the Governor of New York
